seo.title: Verde+ — The Immigration App for Hispanic Families in the U.S.
seo.description: Track your case, scan documents, learn your rights, and connect with your attorney. Free for everyone. Exclusive features for Verde Law clients.

hero.title: Your immigration case, simplified.
hero.subtitle: The first all-in-one platform built for Hispanic immigrants in the United States. Free for everyone — with exclusive features for Verde Law clients.

caseTracker.title: Know exactly where your case stands.
caseTracker.desc: Real-time updates at every step of your immigration matter. From contract signing to final decision, you can see what's happening next — and when.

judgeStats.title: Know your judge before the hearing.
judgeStats.desc: Access real approval statistics for immigration judges in your jurisdiction. Know what you're walking into, so nothing surprises you.
judgeStats.h3: Compare judges in the same court

documentScanner.title: Digitize documents instantly.
documentScanner.desc: Scan passports, work permits, and legal documents straight from your phone. Stored securely. Shareable to the legal team with one tap.

aiAssistant.title: Immediate answers to your questions.
aiAssistant.desc: Our AI assistant answers common immigration questions in Spanish, 24 hours a day. Attorney-verified information on legal topics, in language you can actually understand.

academy.title: Learn your rights.
academy.desc: Free courses, step-by-step guides, and educational resources to understand how immigration works in your favor. Right in the app, at your pace.

community.title: Connect with other immigrants.
community.desc: Share experiences, ask questions, and find support in our community. Moderated for safety and respect.
community.h3: A support network that gets it

download.title: Download Verde+ today.
download.subtitle: Track your case, scan your documents, learn your rights — all in one app, in your language.
